_README: PAN-OS operational command families plus curated live-device commands (ping, logs, system state - SSH/--remote). Values: true | "dev" | false. _default: false = absent flags are off. _carry: false = generator always regenerates fresh (default); _carry: true = generator preserves existing true/dev values across rebuilds. Set _carry: true in this file to protect manual edits from docsupdate. Or put overrides in settings/features/local.json (never touched by generators). Regenerated by app/scripts/generate_feature_flags.py. Inside ARC: feature show | feature find <text> | feature enable|disable|dev <flag>.
